issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a String, but the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type int. The template contains a TODO for this method (no signature). This mismatch between the specification (UML) and the solution will confuse students about the correct return type to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Preferably update the problem statement UML and textual description to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (since it represents a numeric total), or alternatively change the solution and any tests to return String. Ensure the template method TODO includes the chosen signature so students implement the expected type.
